title: What is the overall claims portfolio?
business_value: Establish the overall volume and cost baseline.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS claim_count, COUNT(DISTINCT VehicleID) AS distinct_vehicles, ROUND(SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS total_repair_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS average_repair_cost_inr, MIN(AccidentDate) AS first_accident, MAX(AccidentDate) AS last_accident FROM telematics_claims;

title: How many repeat-incident vehicles are present?
business_value: Understand repeat vehicle incidents; repeats are not inherently suspicious.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vehicles_with_multiple_claims FROM (SELECT VehicleID FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY VehicleID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

title: Which brands account for the most claims?
business_value: Understand portfolio mix and avoid treating raw volume as risk rate.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telematics_claims), 2) AS claim_share_pct FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand ORDER BY claim_count DESC;

title: Which brands have the highest average repair cost?
business_value: Compare claim severity across manufacturers.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr, ROUND(SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS total_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_cost_inr DESC;

title: What share of total repair spend comes from each brand?
business_value: Find where the largest absolute financial exposure sits.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, ROUND(SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS total_cost_inr, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR) / (SELECT SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR) FROM telematics_claims), 2) AS cost_share_pct FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand ORDER BY total_cost_inr DESC;

title: How does impact point relate to repair cost?
business_value: Quantify repair-cost differences by damaged vehicle zone.
sql: SELECT Impact_Point, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS avg_impact_speed_kmh, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(Airbag_Deployed), 2) AS airbag_rate_pct FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Impact_Point ORDER BY avg_cost_inr DESC;

title: How does airbag deployment relate to repair cost?
business_value: Study a severity proxy; airbag deployment is not a causal estimate.
sql: SELECT Airbag_Deployed, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS avg_speed_kmh, ROUND(AVG(G_Force_Impact), 2) AS avg_g_force, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Airbag_Deployed ORDER BY Airbag_Deployed;

title: What are repair costs by impact-speed band?
business_value: Understand the cost curve over increasing impact speeds.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 25 THEN '01 Low (<25)' WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 50 THEN '02 Moderate (25-49)' WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 80 THEN '03 High (50-79)' ELSE '04 Very high (80+)' END AS speed_band, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(G_Force_Impact), 2) AS avg_g_force FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY speed_band ORDER BY speed_band;

title: How does G-force band relate to average cost?
business_value: Use impact acceleration as another severity indicator.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN G_Force_Impact < 2 THEN '01 <2g' WHEN G_Force_Impact < 4 THEN '02 2-4g' WHEN G_Force_Impact < 7 THEN '03 4-7g' ELSE '04 7g+' END AS g_force_band, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS avg_speed_kmh, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY g_force_band ORDER BY g_force_band;

title: Does weather condition correspond to different claim costs?
business_value: Compare descriptive patterns across weather conditions.
sql: SELECT Weather_Condition, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Weather_Condition ORDER BY claim_count DESC;

title: Which road types have the highest average repair cost?
business_value: Inform road-context segmentation and severity reporting.
sql: SELECT Road_Type, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Road_Type ORDER BY avg_cost_inr DESC;

title: Which crash areas carry the largest repair spend?
business_value: Compare volume and financial burden by simulated area.
sql: SELECT Crash_Area, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS total_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Crash_Area ORDER BY total_cost_inr DESC;

title: How many claims occur each month?
business_value: Provide a monthly operational workload baseline.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', AccidentDate) AS accident_month, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS total_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY accident_month ORDER BY accident_month;

title: How does monthly claim count change from the prior month?
business_value: Spot volume changes with a window function.
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', AccidentDate) AS accident_month, COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY accident_month) SELECT accident_month, claim_count, LAG(claim_count) OVER (ORDER BY accident_month) AS prior_month_claims, claim_count - LAG(claim_count) OVER (ORDER BY accident_month) AS month_over_month_change FROM monthly ORDER BY accident_month;

title: Are claims more common on weekdays or weekends?
business_value: Support staffing patterns without inferring causation.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) IN (0,6) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY day_type;

title: At what hours are incidents most frequent?
business_value: Understand simulated hour-of-day workload peaks.
sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) AS accident_hour, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY accident_hour ORDER BY claim_count DESC;

title: How does vehicle age relate to repair cost?
business_value: Segment cost patterns by vehicle age at incident time.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) - Model_Year < 3 THEN '0-2 years' WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) - Model_Year < 7 THEN '3-6 years' WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) - Model_Year < 12 THEN '7-11 years' ELSE '12+ years' END AS vehicle_age_band, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY vehicle_age_band ORDER BY vehicle_age_band;

title: What are the 15 most expensive claims?
business_value: Create a review queue of highest-value repair events.
sql: SELECT ClaimID, AccidentDate, Vehicle_Brand, Crash_Area, Speed_At_Impact_kmh, G_Force_Impact, Airbag_Deployed, Actual_Repair_Cost_INR FROM telematics_claims ORDER BY Actual_Repair_Cost_INR DESC LIMIT 15;

title: Which claims are above average cost by more than two standard deviations?
business_value: Illustrate a transparent statistical outlier rule.
sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR) AS avg_cost, (AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR * Actual_Repair_Cost_INR) - AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR) * AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR)) AS var_cost FROM telematics_claims) SELECT c.ClaimID, c.Vehicle_Brand, c.Speed_At_Impact_kmh, c.G_Force_Impact, c.Actual_Repair_Cost_INR, ROUND(s.avg_cost, 2) AS portfolio_avg_cost FROM telematics_claims c CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE c.Actual_Repair_Cost_INR > s.avg_cost + 2 * sqrt(MAX(s.var_cost, 0)) ORDER BY c.Actual_Repair_Cost_INR DESC;

title: Which vehicles have the most recorded incidents?
business_value: Identify repeated synthetic VehicleID appearances for further context.
sql: SELECT VehicleID, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, ROUND(SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS total_repair_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_repair_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY VehicleID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY incident_count DESC, total_repair_cost_inr DESC LIMIT 20;

title: What is the average cost for repeat versus single-incident vehicles?
business_value: Compare groups while noting repeat identity is simulated.
sql: WITH vehicle_counts AS (SELECT VehicleID, COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY VehicleID) SELECT CASE WHEN v.claim_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat vehicle' ELSE 'Single recorded incident' END AS vehicle_group, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(AVG(c.Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims c JOIN vehicle_counts v ON c.VehicleID = v.VehicleID GROUP BY vehicle_group;

title: How is crash severity distributed by brand?
business_value: Separate brand volume from severity mix.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, CASE WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 25 THEN 'Low' WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 50 THEN 'Moderate' WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 80 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Very high' END AS severity_band, COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand, severity_band ORDER BY Vehicle_Brand, claim_count DESC;

title: How does airbag deployment rate vary by speed band?
business_value: Check whether the generated safety signal behaves plausibly.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 25 THEN 'Low (<25)' WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 50 THEN 'Moderate (25-49)' WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 80 THEN 'High (50-79)' ELSE 'Very high (80+)' END AS speed_band, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(Airbag_Deployed), 2) AS airbag_deployment_pct FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY speed_band ORDER BY speed_band;

title: What are average speed and costs by impact point?
business_value: Compare the mix of impact zones and associated loss amounts.
sql: SELECT Impact_Point, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS avg_speed_kmh, ROUND(AVG(G_Force_Impact), 2) AS avg_g_force, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Impact_Point ORDER BY avg_speed_kmh DESC;

title: How do costs vary across speed quartiles?
business_value: Compare relative cost progression using NTILE windowing.
sql: WITH bands AS (SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY Speed_At_Impact_kmh) AS speed_quartile FROM telematics_claims) SELECT speed_quartile, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(MIN(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS min_speed, ROUND(MAX(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS max_speed, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM bands GROUP BY speed_quartile ORDER BY speed_quartile;

title: Which features accompany the highest repair costs?
business_value: Summarize severity indicators alongside claim cost.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN Airbag_Deployed = 1 THEN 'Airbag deployed' ELSE 'No airbag deployment' END AS airbag_status, Impact_Point, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Speed_At_Impact_kmh), 2) AS avg_speed_kmh, ROUND(AVG(G_Force_Impact), 2) AS avg_g_force, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY airbag_status, Impact_Point ORDER BY avg_cost_inr DESC;

title: What is the repair-cost distribution by percentile group?
business_value: Expose long-tail cost behavior rather than relying only on averages.
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT Actual_Repair_Cost_INR, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY Actual_Repair_Cost_INR) AS cost_decile FROM telematics_claims) SELECT cost_decile, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(MIN(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS min_cost_inr, ROUND(MAX(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS max_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM ranked GROUP BY cost_decile ORDER BY cost_decile;

title: How do claim volume and average cost change by quarter?
business_value: Provide a quarterly view for staffing and trend discussion.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', AccidentDate) AS accident_year, CAST((CAST(strftime('%m', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS INTEGER) AS accident_quarter, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr, ROUND(SUM(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS total_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY accident_year, accident_quarter ORDER BY accident_year, accident_quarter;

title: Are weekend incidents more expensive after grouping by impact point?
business_value: Check whether a simple aggregate is being driven by crash mix.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%w', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) IN (0,6) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, Impact_Point, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY day_type, Impact_Point ORDER BY day_type, avg_cost_inr DESC;

title: What are claim counts and costs by vehicle-age band and brand?
business_value: Support segment-specific repair-cost benchmarking.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) - Model_Year < 3 THEN '0-2 years' WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) - Model_Year < 7 THEN '3-6 years' WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', AccidentDate) AS INTEGER) - Model_Year < 12 THEN '7-11 years' ELSE '12+ years' END AS vehicle_age_band, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_cost_inr FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand, vehicle_age_band HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY Vehicle_Brand, avg_cost_inr DESC;

title: How many garages specialize in each vehicle brand?
business_value: Measure supply depth by make.
sql: SELECT Brand_Specialization AS Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS garage_count, SUM(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_stock_garages, SUM(CASE WHEN Preferred_Partner = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_garages FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Brand_Specialization ORDER BY garage_count DESC;

title: What is parts availability by brand?
business_value: Identify makes where routing choices may be constrained.
sql: SELECT Brand_Specialization AS Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS garage_count, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS in_stock_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_stock_garages FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Brand_Specialization ORDER BY in_stock_pct;

title: Which areas have the largest preferred-partner share?
business_value: Review network composition by area.
sql: SELECT Area, COUNT(*) AS garage_count, SUM(CASE WHEN Preferred_Partner = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_count, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN Preferred_Partner = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS preferred_share_pct FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Area ORDER BY preferred_share_pct DESC;

title: Which areas have the greatest daily service capacity?
business_value: Compare total intake capacity across simulated service areas.
sql: SELECT Area, COUNT(*) AS garage_count, SUM(Daily_Service_Capacity) AS total_daily_capacity, ROUND(AVG(Daily_Service_Capacity), 1) AS avg_capacity_per_garage FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Area ORDER BY total_daily_capacity DESC;

title: Which garage-specialization groups have longer turnaround?
business_value: Find potential cycle-time bottlenecks in the simulated network.
sql: SELECT Brand_Specialization AS Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS garage_count, ROUND(AVG(Avg_Repair_Turnaround_Days), 2) AS avg_turnaround_days, ROUND(MIN(Avg_Repair_Turnaround_Days), 2) AS min_turnaround_days, ROUND(MAX(Avg_Repair_Turnaround_Days), 2) AS max_turnaround_days FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Brand_Specialization ORDER BY avg_turnaround_days DESC;

title: How do simulated labor rates vary by area?
business_value: Review cost-of-service differences in the garage network.
sql: SELECT Area, COUNT(*) AS garage_count, ROUND(AVG(Labor_Rate_INR_Per_Hour), 2) AS avg_labor_rate_inr_hour, MIN(Labor_Rate_INR_Per_Hour) AS min_labor_rate, MAX(Labor_Rate_INR_Per_Hour) AS max_labor_rate FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Area ORDER BY avg_labor_rate_inr_hour DESC;

title: Which vehicle brands have out-of-stock garages?
business_value: Plan spare-parts availability improvements.
sql: SELECT Brand_Specialization AS Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS garage_count, SUM(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_stock_count, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS out_of_stock_pct FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Brand_Specialization HAVING out_of_stock_count > 0 ORDER BY out_of_stock_pct DESC;

title: Is garage supply proportional to the claim mix by brand?
business_value: Compare demand share with eligible garage supply share.
sql: WITH demand AS (SELECT Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS claim_count FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand), supply AS (SELECT Brand_Specialization AS Vehicle_Brand, SUM(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eligible_garages FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Brand_Specialization), totals AS (SELECT SUM(claim_count) AS total_claims FROM demand), total_supply AS (SELECT SUM(eligible_garages) AS total_garages FROM supply) SELECT d.Vehicle_Brand, d.claim_count, s.eligible_garages, ROUND(100.0 * d.claim_count / t.total_claims, 2) AS demand_share_pct, ROUND(100.0 * s.eligible_garages / ts.total_garages, 2) AS eligible_supply_share_pct, ROUND(1.0 * d.claim_count / NULLIF(s.eligible_garages, 0), 2) AS claims_per_eligible_garage FROM demand d JOIN supply s ON d.Vehicle_Brand = s.Vehicle_Brand CROSS JOIN totals t CROSS JOIN total_supply ts ORDER BY claims_per_eligible_garage DESC;

title: Which brands have the fewest in-stock preferred garages?
business_value: Locate potential preferred-network coverage gaps.
sql: SELECT Brand_Specialization AS Vehicle_Brand, SUM(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 1 AND Preferred_Partner = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_in_stock_garages, SUM(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_in_stock_garages FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Brand_Specialization ORDER BY preferred_in_stock_garages ASC, all_in_stock_garages ASC;

title: What is the average capacity-to-turnaround profile by area?
business_value: Compare network capacity with simulated repair duration.
sql: SELECT Area, COUNT(*) AS garage_count, ROUND(AVG(Daily_Service_Capacity), 2) AS avg_daily_capacity, ROUND(AVG(Avg_Repair_Turnaround_Days), 2) AS avg_turnaround_days, ROUND(AVG(Daily_Service_Capacity / NULLIF(Avg_Repair_Turnaround_Days, 0)), 2) AS capacity_per_turnaround_day FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Area ORDER BY capacity_per_turnaround_day DESC;

title: How many routes used the preferred-partner fallback?
business_value: Show whether routing had to relax the preferred-partner condition.
sql: SELECT Preferred_Fallback_Used, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM garage_routing), 2) AS share_pct FROM garage_routing GROUP BY Preferred_Fallback_Used;

title: What are average route distance and cycle time by brand?
business_value: Compare routing effort across vehicle makes.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS routed_claims, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Distance_km), 2) AS avg_distance_km, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Travel_Minutes), 1) AS avg_travel_minutes, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Turnaround_Days), 2) AS avg_turnaround_days, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Est_Cycle_Hours), 2) AS avg_estimated_cycle_hours FROM garage_routing GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand ORDER BY avg_estimated_cycle_hours DESC;

title: Which garages receive the most routing recommendations?
business_value: Show how the routing heuristic distributes simulated work.
sql: SELECT r.Recommended_GarageID, g.Garage_Name, g.Area, g.Brand_Specialization, COUNT(*) AS recommended_claims, g.Daily_Service_Capacity, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(*) / g.Daily_Service_Capacity, 2) AS claims_per_capacity_unit_proxy FROM garage_routing r JOIN partner_garages g ON r.Recommended_GarageID = g.GarageID GROUP BY r.Recommended_GarageID, g.Garage_Name, g.Area, g.Brand_Specialization, g.Daily_Service_Capacity ORDER BY recommended_claims DESC LIMIT 20;

title: Which crash areas have the longest average garage route?
business_value: Identify simulated geography with more travel burden.
sql: SELECT Crash_Area, COUNT(*) AS routed_claims, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Distance_km), 2) AS avg_distance_km, ROUND(MAX(Recommended_Garage_Distance_km), 2) AS max_distance_km, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Travel_Minutes), 1) AS avg_travel_minutes FROM garage_routing GROUP BY Crash_Area ORDER BY avg_distance_km DESC;

title: How often is the balanced recommendation farther than the nearest eligible garage?
business_value: Quantify the distance-versus-turnaround/capacity trade-off.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS claims_routed, SUM(CASE WHEN Recommended_GarageID <> Nearest_Eligible_GarageID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recommendation_differs_from_nearest, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN Recommended_GarageID <> Nearest_Eligible_GarageID THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS changed_recommendation_pct, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Distance_km - Nearest_Eligible_Garage_Distance_km), 3) AS avg_extra_distance_km FROM garage_routing;

title: How many claims are routed beyond 10 kilometres?
business_value: Find longer-distance routing cases for manual review.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS claims_over_10km, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM garage_routing), 2) AS share_pct, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Distance_km), 2) AS avg_distance_over_10km FROM garage_routing WHERE Recommended_Garage_Distance_km > 10;

title: What is routing distance by garage policy?
business_value: Compare preferred-only routing with fallback scenarios.
sql: SELECT Candidate_Policy, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Distance_km), 2) AS avg_distance_km, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Turnaround_Days), 2) AS avg_turnaround_days, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Est_Cycle_Hours), 2) AS avg_cycle_hours FROM garage_routing GROUP BY Candidate_Policy ORDER BY claims DESC;

preview.Candidate_Policy: Preferred partner + brand match + parts in stock

title: Where are route recommendation counts concentrated?
business_value: Examine routing allocations by area and garage specialization.
sql: SELECT Crash_Area, Recommended_Garage_Area, COUNT(*) AS route_count, ROUND(AVG(Recommended_Garage_Distance_km), 2) AS avg_distance_km FROM garage_routing GROUP BY Crash_Area, Recommended_Garage_Area ORDER BY route_count DESC LIMIT 25;

title: What is holdout prediction error by impact-speed band?
business_value: Check where model performance varies with crash severity.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 25 THEN 'Low (<25)' WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 50 THEN 'Moderate (25-49)' WHEN Speed_At_Impact_kmh < 80 THEN 'High (50-79)' ELSE 'Very high (80+)' END AS speed_band, COUNT(*) AS holdout_claims, ROUND(AVG(Absolute_Error_INR), 2) AS mae_inr, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_actual_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Predicted_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_predicted_cost_inr FROM holdout_predictions GROUP BY speed_band ORDER BY speed_band;

title: Which brands have the largest holdout prediction errors?
business_value: Identify vehicle makes where repair-cost estimates need caution.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS holdout_claims, ROUND(AVG(Absolute_Error_INR), 2) AS mae_inr, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_actual_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Predicted_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_predicted_cost_inr FROM holdout_predictions GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY mae_inr DESC;

title: What are the most poorly predicted holdout claims?
business_value: Create examples for error analysis, not automatic claim denials.
sql: SELECT ClaimID, AccidentDate, Vehicle_Brand, Speed_At_Impact_kmh, G_Force_Impact, Airbag_Deployed, Actual_Repair_Cost_INR, Predicted_Repair_Cost_INR, Absolute_Error_INR FROM holdout_predictions ORDER BY Absolute_Error_INR DESC LIMIT 20;

title: Does prediction bias differ across vehicle makes?
business_value: Inspect signed errors for systematic over- or underprediction.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS holdout_claims, ROUND(AVG(Signed_Error_INR), 2) AS mean_signed_error_inr, ROUND(AVG(Absolute_Error_INR), 2) AS mean_absolute_error_inr FROM holdout_predictions GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY ABS(AVG(Signed_Error_INR)) DESC;

title: How close are actual and predicted costs by impact point?
business_value: Compare error patterns across collision zones.
sql: SELECT Impact_Point, COUNT(*) AS holdout_claims, ROUND(AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_actual_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Predicted_Repair_Cost_INR), 2) AS avg_predicted_cost_inr, ROUND(AVG(Absolute_Error_INR), 2) AS mae_inr FROM holdout_predictions GROUP BY Impact_Point ORDER BY mae_inr DESC;

title: How does model MAE compare to a training-period mean baseline by brand?
business_value: Compare predictions relative to the mean cost in the training period.
sql: SELECT Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS holdout_claims, ROUND(AVG(Absolute_Error_INR), 2) AS model_mae_inr, ROUND(AVG(ABS(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR - (SELECT AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR) FROM telematics_claims WHERE AccidentDate < (SELECT MIN(AccidentDate) FROM holdout_predictions)))), 2) AS benchmark_mae_inr FROM holdout_predictions GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY model_mae_inr DESC;

title: Which brands combine high demand with low preferred in-stock coverage?
business_value: Create a prioritized network improvement view.
sql: WITH demand AS (SELECT Vehicle_Brand, COUNT(*) AS claim_count, AVG(Actual_Repair_Cost_INR) AS avg_cost FROM telematics_claims GROUP BY Vehicle_Brand), network AS (SELECT Brand_Specialization AS Vehicle_Brand, SUM(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 1 AND Preferred_Partner = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_stock_garages, SUM(CASE WHEN Parts_Available = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_stock_garages FROM partner_garages GROUP BY Brand_Specialization) SELECT d.Vehicle_Brand, d.claim_count, ROUND(d.avg_cost, 2) AS avg_cost_inr, n.preferred_stock_garages, n.all_stock_garages, ROUND(1.0 * d.claim_count / NULLIF(n.preferred_stock_garages, 0), 2) AS claims_per_preferred_stock_garage FROM demand d JOIN network n ON d.Vehicle_Brand = n.Vehicle_Brand ORDER BY claims_per_preferred_stock_garage DESC;
